thread:
maria_s: Hey — customer reported a 400 from POST /v1/rerank. Error: "Invalid request: items must be array". Body they sent looks fine at first glance. Any quick ideas?

jake_eng: Can you paste the exact request body and the full response (body + status)? Also which SDK/version are they using?

maria_s: Pasted below (redacted):
```json
{
  "items": {"id": "abc123", "query": "Which product is cheaper?"},
  "candidates": {
    "0": {"text": "Product A", "score": 0.2},
    "1": {"text": "Product B", "score": 0.8}
  },
  "top_k": "1",
}
```
Server responded: 400, body: {"error":"Invalid request: items must be array"}  — customer saw this intermittently when batching from mobile.

support-bot: Logged: request_id=req_9f3b, route=/v1/rerank, status=400, validation_error=items: expected array, top_k: expected integer

jake_eng: Ok — two issues visible: (1) items is an object, not an array (client serializes single-item batch as object with numeric keys), (2) top_k is a string. Also there's a trailing comma which some servers tolerate but our parser chokes on in strict mode — could be throwing earlier in their pipeline.

jake_eng: Repro steps (local):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"items": [{"id": "abc123","query": "Which product is cheaper?"}], "candidates": [[{"id":"c0","text":"Product A"},{"id":"c1","text":"Product B"}]], "top_k": 1 }'
```
This returns 200 + expected scores. If I send the malformed body from above I get the same 400 and the exact validation_error in the logs.

olivia_pm: Customer is on Dedicated and this is blocking a pilot. They asked for an ETA to fix client-side repro guidance. Ticket TKT-2417 created. :eyes:

sachin_se: Can we improve the error payload to show which field failed (e.g., errors: [{"path":"items","msg":"must be array"}])? That would reduce support load.

jake_eng: Agreed. I'll file an infra task to add field-level validation messages. Short term: reply to customer with two fixes — ensure items is an array even for single item, and coerce top_k to a number. Also share the corrected example payload: 
```json
{
  "items": [{"id": "abc123", "query": "Which product is cheaper?"}],
  "candidates": [[{"id": "c0", "text": "Product A"}, {"id": "c1", "text": "Product B"}]],
  "top_k": 1
}
```

maria_s: Sending that to the customer now. They're happy to accept the workaround. I'll update the SDK team with the repro and the suggested server-side error change.

jake_eng: Thanks — I'll link TKT-2417 to the infra ticket for better errors and put a small guard in the rerank handler to normalize single-object -> [object] for a short-term mitigation.
